scope: Repair lost measurement input diagnostics at the read API, then offline regression and one independent native/debug acceptance. No paid models, production-game edits, formal frontend or Claude Code changes, automatic workflow retry, or relaxed Preview/export gates.
rootCause: The read route reconstructed freshness from the Preview selection result/error and discarded the existing source/report/artifact/check input comparisons. Selection also refuses interrupted or busy runs before comparing inputs.

fix.behavior: Preserve inspectAgentMeasurementInputs diagnostics in freshness. inputsCurrent describes the observed input comparison. Keep the existing selectAgentMeasuredBuild refusal as current:false/code/reason, and expose selection.eligible separately. A matching old artifact does not authorize Preview/export or imply quality.
unchanged: mandatory native permission and writer checks
fix.tradeoff: The read route uses both existing read-only inspection and the existing selection function. For a selectable or stale completed measurement this repeats input inspection. No new cache, shared acceptance token, automatic build or retry was introduced.

offlineRegression.fixtureCorrection: The new API test initially used viewer, which correctly received 403 for preview.manage before reaching stale-selection refusal. Changed only the synthetic test user to owner and explicitly verified 409 gate refusals; no real account or product permission change.
coverage: interrupted turn with matching inputs remains ineligible
